deployment.platform: Cloudflare Pages proxy and Cloudflare Worker

homepage.evidence: The published English protocol-document homepage was confirmed in the production in-app browser on desktop.

public_example_get.evidence: The actual published example GET and its returned Continue link worked in the in-app browser. The returned quote link verified the saved note and 1,370 TRY total. This browser result is separate from native ChatGPT compatibility.

merchant_comparison.evidence: The production browser playground returned three independent catalog-backed outcomes for the same 25-red-rose request.

outcomes.reason: Red roses are out of stock; pink roses are an alternative

conversation_continuity.evidence: The production merchant page preserved the follow-up card message and the original stem count, budget, delivery district, and deadline.

quote.evidence: The server-rendered product handoff showed the saved selection and delivery-inclusive quote using a merchant link from the source evidence.

human_handoff.evidence: A direct merchant product link with the session handle rendered the prepared selection; client JavaScript then removed the handle from the address bar. The old playground action was bypassed because of its JSON-negotiation bug.

simulated_order.evidence: With fictional recipient/address inputs and the confirmation checkbox selected, Create Demo Order returned a confirmation displaying the correct total, delivery, and no-payment notice.
simulated_order.idempotency: Not repeated in the production browser; covered by the local HTTP smoke test.

prepared_order_fix.change: Programmatic quote and checkout GETs explicitly request format=json and Accept: application/json. Human-facing protocol links retain their default representation.
prepared_order_fix.production_retest: Playground button retest pending; direct merchant handoff has passed

native_fetch_latency_fix.change: All model stages share one default 7000 ms deadline; later stages use the remaining time or return the existing honest provider fallback.
native_fetch_latency_fix.validation: The focused mocked-provider test and npm run typecheck passed.
native_fetch_latency_fix.production_retest: Browser example GET passed; native agent question remains unverified

homepage.surface: Codex in-app browser, local mobile viewport
homepage.evidence: The English protocol-document homepage fits the viewport without horizontal overflow, omits the previous hero/shop/playground/activity sections, and retains the canonical-origin native ChatGPT prompt CTA.
homepage.production_retest: Passed on production desktop; production mobile was not separately checked

automated_http_smoke.evidence: Node fetch, Python urllib, and bounded IPv4 curl could resolve the production domain but received TLS connection resets before an HTTP response. No simulated order was created by these attempts.

native_chatgpt.surface: An existing conversation in native ChatGPT, inspected in the user's browser

storefront_catalog_comparison.evidence: ChatGPT read the storefront pages and compared their public catalog itself: 25 red roses at 1,370 TRY for today at 19:30, 20 red roses at 1,270 TRY for tomorrow, and a shop without red-rose stock. ChatGPT explicitly said the website's agent did not answer; this is not evidence of a completed AskAgent conversation.

agent_discovery.evidence: ChatGPT's web tool could read all three merchant AskAgent discovery endpoints.

dynamic_agent_question.evidence: ChatGPT's web tool could not reach either the short question GET or the original question GET. No response from the site's agent was observed.

dynamic_order_preparation.evidence: ChatGPT reported an endpoint timeout in the earlier attempt. Later question URLs were inaccessible to its web tool; actual conversation, quote, card-message continuity, and session checkout could not be verified.

native_chatgpt.latest_revision_evidence: A new native ChatGPT attempt read all three discovery endpoints, but question URL access failed and no site-agent reply, conversation handle, or quote was returned. A further direct example-link attempt is still in progress.
